desc_aggregate_enabled.message: Combine multiple paragraphs into a single translation request to improve efficiency.

desc_color_scheme.message: Controls the light/dark appearance of the settings page and popup; it does not affect page translation output.

desc_custom_tones.message: Define your own translation tones; they appear alongside the built-in ones.

desc_enable_polysemy.message: Applies to short text in the popup only. For a single word or phrase it also lists part of speech, senses and phonetics. Page translation never uses it, to avoid polluting the page structure.

desc_global_override_style.message: Ignore per-service styles and force the selected style for every service.

desc_global_override_tone.message: Override per-service tones and use the selected tone everywhere.

desc_global_prompt.message: This prompt is used for all providers unless overridden.

desc_load_balance.message: When enabled, translation requests are distributed across multiple providers by weight. Toggle quickly from the Popup panel.

desc_model_fallback.message: When the preferred model fails, try the remaining models of this provider as backups.

desc_prompt_mode_append.message: Leave empty to use only the global prompt. When filled, it is appended after the global prompt as extra instructions for this service.

desc_prompt_mode_override.message: Leave empty to use the global prompt. When filled, it fully replaces the global prompt for this service.

desc_request_settings.message: Applies to all translation requests (both aggregate and non-aggregate).

desc_services_config.message: Configure a Single (one provider) or Pool (weighted) service as the primary translation channel.

desc_use_service_default_style.message: Determined by the style set in each service's advanced settings.

desc_use_service_default_tone.message: Determined by the tone set in the active service's advanced settings.

empty_no_service_desc.message: Click “New translation service” in the top right to create one.

error_all_models_failed.message: All translation models failed. Check the endpoint, API key and network.

error_empty_response.message: The model returned an empty translation. Retry or switch models.

error_image_invalid_format.message: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are supported.

error_image_load_failed.message: Couldn't read the image. The file may be corrupted.

error_image_no_text.message: No translatable text was found in the image.

error_image_too_large.message: Image is too large: max 20MB and 16384px on the longest side.

error_image_translate_http_error.message: The recognition request failed. Check the service URL, API key and model configuration.

error_image_translate_model_unsupported.message: The selected model doesn't support image input. Pick a model marked "Supports image input" in settings.

error_image_translate_no_vision_model.message: No model supports image input. Enable "Supports image input" for a model in settings.

error_image_translate_recognize_failed.message: Couldn't recognize text in the image. Please try again.

error_image_translate_vision_timeout.message: Recognizing image text timed out. Retry or switch to a faster vision model.

error_import_decrypt_failed.message: Decryption failed: wrong passphrase or corrupted file.

error_import_passphrase_required.message: This backup is encrypted. Please enter the passphrase to import.

error_invalid_base_url.message: Endpoint URL must be a full URL starting with http:// or https://

error_invalid_import_version.message: This backup was created by a newer version. Please update the extension first.

error_no_active_service.message: No active translation service. Please configure one in settings.

error_no_models.message: No translation models available. Please configure providers in settings.

error_required_fields.message: Name and Base URL are required

error_settings_quota_exceeded.message: Settings exceed the browser sync storage quota. Reduce providers or shorten prompts and retry.

extDescription.message: A modern browser translation extension based on large language models, compatible with various LLM service providers.

hint_api_key.message: If set, Authorization: Bearer header will be sent automatically. You can still override it in custom headers.

hint_content_type_auto.message: Content-Type is injected automatically by the request layer; no need to set it here.

hint_export_passphrase.message: Leave empty to export plaintext JSON. With a passphrase, the export is encrypted with AES-GCM. The passphrase cannot be recovered if lost.

hint_export_passphrase_warn.message: API keys detected — encrypting the export is strongly recommended. Warning: a lost passphrase makes the export unrecoverable.

hint_extra_body_override.message: Standalone fields above take precedence over keys of the same name in this JSON.

hint_input_loading_pulse_duration.message: Duration for one animation cycle. 800-1600 is usually comfortable.

hint_input_loading_pulse_easing.message: Controls the transition rhythm between keyframes.

hint_input_shortcut_key.message: Press three times to translate, then three times again to restore; default Space.

hint_input_translation_target_language.message: Input box translation typically translates from your native language to a foreign language. Set the default target language here.

hint_max_tokens.message: Maximum tokens per response (1 token ≈ 0.75 English words or 1~2 Chinese characters). Increase if translations are being cut off.

hint_model_order.message: Model order determines fallback priority. Models listed first are tried first.

hint_native_language.message: Your native language. Web and popup translations target this language by default.

hint_second_language.message: In popup translation, when the input is in your native language, it is translated into this language.

hint_stream.message: When enabled, results are parsed incrementally via SSE. Note: long inputs may hit the request timeout — increase it in General settings if needed.

hint_supports_vision.message: Enable this to use the model for translating text in images. Only models with this flag are used for image translation.

hint_temperature.message: Controls randomness. Lower values make translations more precise and consistent (recommended 0~0.3); higher values produce more creative output.

hint_test_provider.message: Test the current provider by sending a random-language greeting. Result will be translated into your native language.

hint_top_p.message: Nucleus sampling that controls word diversity. 1.0 considers all candidates; lower values are more conservative. Temperature alone is usually sufficient — no need to tweak both.

hint_ui_language.message: Controls the language of this extension's UI

label_enable_polysemy.message: Enable polysemy dictionary mode in the popup

label_tone_instruction.message: Prompt instruction (e.g. Translate in Classical Chinese style…)

options_subtitle.message: Configure your OpenAI-compatible translation providers and preferences

placeholder_tone_instruction.message: Enter the prompt instructions this tone should follow…

popup_no_service_desc.message: Add a provider and a translation service in settings first, then translate here.

popup_page_translation_unavailable.message: Page translation is unavailable on this page

settings_warnings_prefix.message: Some settings could not be read; these entries were skipped (everything else is unchanged):

statistics_no_data_hint.message: Statistics will appear here after using the translation feature

statistics_response_time_desc.message: Average response time and failure count per provider/model (based on last 100 requests)

statistics_subtitle.message: Translation request performance and usage overview

statistics_token_usage_desc.message: Token consumption stacked by provider and model (daily accumulation for current month)

style_original_desc.message: Replace text while preserving element structure

theme_aurora_desc.message: Soft sage teal tone, text pulses in and out with a gentle cadence — calm and fresh

theme_cosmic_desc.message: Soft dusty rose tone, text pulses in and out with a gentle cadence — warm without being loud

theme_indigo_desc.message: Soft lavender tone, text pulses in and out with a gentle cadence — warm and understated

theme_monochrome_desc.message: Pure opacity pulse with zero chroma — deeply immersive and distraction-free

toast_export_encrypted_remember.message: Encrypted backup generated. Keep the passphrase safe — it cannot be recovered.

tone_formal_desc.message: Dignified, precise, suitable for formal contexts

tone_literary_desc.message: Elegant language, rich vocabulary, preserves rhetoric

tone_no_extra_instruction.message: (no extra instruction; uses the default natural style)
